description: Asks what Weekday returns for 2024-03-03 under each first-day-of-week value from -1 to 8, for the Automation date zero and its neighbours, a fractional negative, Null, text, a time-carrying date, the range limits, a fractional or text first-day argument, and invalid argument counts. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
